summary: I am a Chemical Engineer with over 43 years of professional experience, including more than four decades in the oil and gas industry, spanning upstream production operations and leadership roles in Health, Safety and Environment (HSE). I also hold an International Diploma in Safety Management from the British Safety Council. I began my career in upstream oil and gas production operations, Over the years, my professional journey evolved toward HSE leadership, where I had the opportunity to contribute to strengthening safety culture and systems within large and complex industrial environments. I superannuated from Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) as Executive Director after 36 years of service. In my final assignment, I served as Head of Offshore Safety, with overall responsibility for HSE oversight of ONGC’s offshore operations across India’s western and eastern offshore assets. I was closely involved in strengthening safety governance, improving operational safety practices, and enhancing risk management systems across offshore installations. I was instrumental in driving the development and implementation of ONGC’s Integrated QHSE Management System based on ISO standards, which helped institutionalize structured quality, safety, health, and environmental management practices across the organization. I have also been actively associated with national regulatory and policy frameworks for offshore safety. I contributed to the development of India’s first Offshore Safety Rules for the hydrocarbon sector introduced in 2008. Following my superannuation from ONGC, I served as Chief Safety Advisor at the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH) under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, where I participated in policy discussions, regulatory oversight, and strategic safety initiatives related to India’s upstream petroleum sector. I continue to remain actively engaged with the industry as an independent consultant, trainer, and HSE domain expert, working with regulatory bodies, companies, and professional institutions. I am currently chairing the committee responsible for the first revision of India’s Offshore Safety Rules. With over two decades of experience in professional training, I continue to conduct programmes for industry professionals on operational safety, process safety, and safety leadership. I remain committed to supporting the industry in advancing safety culture, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence through consulting, training, audits, and participation in professional and regulatory forums.
